correctness.rationale: The Sidon denominator equals the circumradius of the Minkowski sum of the scaled regular m-gons. Perimeter additivity, the at-most-mn edge count, and the sharp maximal-perimeter polygon-in-a-disk lemma yield the bound. The equality chain forces a regular mn-gon, equal summand edge lengths, and distinct interlacing edge-direction classes, giving exactly the stated extremizers. The proof is uniform for all m>=3 and n>=2.
